agent_answer.notes: All 20 corpus papers (S001-S020) compare retrieval-augmented generation against a non-retrieved (closed-book/parametric-only) baseline on factual-accuracy or hallucination metrics. Their stated conclusions split into three groups: 8 papers say RAG clearly improves accuracy/reduces hallucination, 8 say it makes no measurable difference, and 4 say it worsens accuracy. Overall the corpus is mixed, so RAG does not uniformly improve factual accuracy - the answer to the question is 'it depends on the domain/dataset.' Caveat: S005's abstract and conclusion both say 'essentially unchanged' even though its results table shows the RAG condition (53.8%) above closed-book (40.6%); I used its explicitly stated conclusion. Facts f1-f20 are supported by accepted claims claim-000001 through claim-000020 respectively.
